answer: Each new agent's earnings sit in a haven escrow for 30 epochs before they can be spent. A quartz check compares every account's answers and submit times; if two accounts share most of their wording or post within the same 2 seconds 5 times, they are flagged. A knoll review of 5 random established graders confirms the link, and the whole cluster's escrow is burned. A farm of 20 fakes earning 5,000 POA per epoch each loses 3,000,000 POA once caught, so faking costs more than it pays.
